subject: English

sub_questions.ms_text:
Level 1: 1-2 marks
• Basic identification and little understanding of the language and/or structure used by writers to achieve effects.
• The use of references is limited.

Level 2: 3-4 marks
• Some understanding of and comment on language and structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary.
• The selection of references is valid, but not developed.

Level 3: 5-6 marks
• Clear understanding and explanation of language and structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary and sentence structure.
• The selection of references is appropriate and relevant to the points being made.

Level 4: 7-8 marks
• Thorough understanding and exploration of language and structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary, sentence structure and other language features.
• The selection of references is detailed, appropriate and fully supports the points being made.

Level 5: 9-10 marks
• Perceptive understanding and analysis of language and structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary, sentence structure and other language features.
• The selection of references is discriminating and clarifies the points being made.

Level      Mark   AO2 Understand and analyse how writers use linguistic and

FULL marking criteria for sub-question 5: Level-based question with a maximum of 10 marks. The levels are as follows: Level 0: No rewardable material; Level 1: 1-2 marks - Basic identification and little understanding of the language and/or structure used by writers to achieve effects; Level 2: 3-4 marks - Some understanding of and comment on language and/or structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary; Level 3: 5-6 marks - Clear understanding and explanation of language and/or structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary and sentence structure; Level 4: 7-8 marks - Thorough understanding and exploration of language and/or structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary, sentence structure, and other language features; Level 5: 9-10 marks - Perceptive understanding and analysis of language and/or structure and how these are used by writers to achieve effects, including use of vocabulary, sentence structure, and other language features. The response must demonstrate an ability to understand and analyze the writers' ideas and perspectives, as well as how these are conveyed.
